description: International route pool for B2C scenario generation. Routes are added only after being confirmed live against the B2C beta API — see docs/changes/ for the verification session each entry traces back to. Do not add a route/airline pairing without a live confirmation; an empty pool fails scenario generation fast rather than falling back to a fabricated route (CLAUDE.md rule 0).
